title: 5 Friends, 120 Photos? Factorial Explained Simply | Class 11 Maths
description:
Five friends want one photo in a row. Aarav thought taking every possible photo would be quick, but it takes 120 photos. Why so many? In this animated lesson for Class 11 Maths (NCERT Chapter 6, Permutations and Combinations) we meet factorial notation, the short way to write a long product.

You will fill five spots one by one with the counting rule, then watch a live chart grow as friends join the row, from 1 way to more than three and a half million. We read the NCERT definition of n!, see why n! = n x (n - 1)! with boxes inside boxes, and find out why 0! = 1. A side-by-side of (5 - 3)! and 5! - 3!, two pause-and-think checks, NCERT Example 8 worked step by step, the exam trap about 0!, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Follows the NCERT book. Useful for CBSE, ICSE (ISC), Karnataka PUC and other state boards, and JEE.

In this video:
0:00 5 friends, 1 photo: why 120 ways?
0:25 Fill the spots with the counting rule
0:46 Live: add one more friend
1:07 What n! means (NCERT)
1:43 Why 0! = 1
2:05 (5 - 3)! vs 5! - 3!
2:50 Worked example: NCERT Example 8
3:30 Exam trap: 0! is not 0
4:01 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
4:35 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode (Ep 54): Permutations of Distinct Objects. Choose a captain and a vice captain: order matters.
